cells.anchor: Novy-Marx & Velikov (2016) sS rule 10%/20% on deciles, scaled 2:1 to quintiles: enter top 20%, retain to top 40%
milder 3:2 band (enter top 20%, retain to top 30%); dose-response companion
Qlib benchmark topk=50, n_drop=5 (10% of k) on a 250-name universe where a quintile is 50 names
4 rebalances x 5 sessions = 20 sessions ~ the 21-session label horizon

criteria.T1_turnover_cut: annualised one-way turnover <= 0.70 x control (a cut of at least 30%)
criteria.T2_gross_retention: mean gross period return >= 0.75 x control's
criteria.T3_net_gain: paired moving-block bootstrap of (net Sharpe at 10 bp, treatment - control): the one-sided lower bound at level 1 - 0.05/4 is > 0
criteria.T4_fold_consistency: mean net period return exceeds control's in at least 6 of the 8 folds
criteria.carry_forward: if more than one cell is MECHANISM_CONFIRMED, the one with the highest T2 gross-retention ratio is the mechanism frozen for EXP-009B/C; ties by fewer parameters

classification.MECHANISM_CONFIRMED: T1 and T2 and T3 and T4
classification.NO_RELIABLE_NET_GAIN: T1 and T2 and (not T3 or not T4)

criteria.promotion: NOT ASSESSED - this study cannot promote a model

validity.on_failure: INVALID - no treatment result is reported

holdout.cutoff: the sealed window in experiments/EXP-006/metrics.json is never read

inference.note: overlap: 21-session labels every 5 sessions give ~4.2 periods of dependence

input.note: frozen out-of-sample predictions; never refit, never altered
